On January 5, 2017, it was announced that Tilly had signed for the upcoming "Cult of Chucky".
Andy Barclay | Andrew William "Andy" Barclay is a fictional character and protagonist of the "Child's Play" horror film series.  He is a young boy who, after receiving a Good Guy doll for his sixth birthday, is the prime suspect in a series of mysterious murders.
